controls.title: Root account MFA
controls.remediation: Enable and verify root MFA or document the applicable centralized root-access design.
controls.review_procedure: Inspect root-access governance, emergency access and periodic access reviews. Root MFA alone does not establish least privilege.
controls.scope_limit: One account-summary root MFA flag; not IAM user MFA, role permissions or an account-wide identity assessment.
controls.responsibility: Customer / shared: validate provider boundaries for the workload

controls.title: Bucket public-access baseline
controls.remediation: Review the intended access model, set the four bucket-level protections where appropriate, then recollect evidence.
controls.review_procedure: Inspect account/organization settings, bucket policies, access points and approved exceptions before concluding exposure.
controls.scope_limit: Bucket-level strict baseline only. A false flag is not proof of public exposure; higher-level controls may restrict access.

controls.title: Trail coverage & integrity settings
controls.remediation: Validate trail coverage, logging status and integrity settings; verify delivery before recollecting.
controls.review_procedure: Inspect management/data event selectors, actual delivery, retention and digest validation results.
controls.scope_limit: One normalized trail: IsLogging comes from get-trail-status, other fields from describe-trails. Flags do not prove delivery or validated digests.

controls.title: Customer key rotation
controls.remediation: Confirm this key supports automatic rotation; enable it or document an approved alternative lifecycle control.
controls.review_procedure: Inspect key type, origin, ownership, key policy, access and destruction controls.
controls.scope_limit: One eligible customer-managed symmetric encryption key. Automatic rotation is not supported by every KMS key type.

controls.review_procedure: Review the exercise timeline, escalation contacts, response evidence and closure of lessons learned.

controls.title: Recovery validation

controls.review_procedure: Compare measured recovery results with approved RTO/RPO and inspect test evidence and unresolved actions.

controls.title: Provider assurance review
controls.remediation: Obtain current scoped assurance and document complementary customer controls.
controls.review_procedure: Check provider assurance scope, period, exclusions, subservice organizations, exceptions and customer responsibilities.
controls.scope_limit: A provider report does not certify the customer workload. CSAP and financial-sector CSP Safety are separate schemes.
